title: Light barrier: minimum round-trip latency
caption: The propagation floor under any remote path, before routing, queuing, or compute. At ~5 ms per 1,000 km round trip, a 10 ms budget dies on distance alone.

symbols.name: round-trip floor
symbols.meaning: minimum time for a signal to go and return; no remote compute can shrink it

symbols.name: one-way distance
symbols.meaning: path length from client to data center, km

symbols.name: propagation speed in fiber
symbols.meaning: ~200,000 km/s, about two-thirds of c in vacuum because light slows in glass

title: Power wall: dynamic power is cubic in frequency
latex: P \propto C\,V^{2}\,f \quad\xrightarrow{\ V\propto f\ }\quad P \propto f^{3}
caption: Raising the clock also raises the voltage needed to switch reliably. Both effects multiply, so doubling f can cost ~8x the power: why clocks froze ~2005 and phones throttle.

symbols.name: dynamic power
symbols.meaning: energy per second spent switching transistors, becomes heat

symbols.name: switched capacitance
symbols.meaning: charge moved per clock edge; set by circuit size, not speed

symbols.name: supply voltage
symbols.meaning: must rise with f to keep switching reliable

symbols.name: clock frequency
symbols.meaning: switching rate; the lever that now costs cubed power

title: Memory wall: compute outgrows bandwidth
caption: Annual growth factors, not speeds. A ratio above 1 compounds: over a decade the compute-to-bandwidth gap opens ~16x, so movement takes a rising share of time and energy.

symbols.name: divergence ratio
symbols.meaning: how much faster compute grows than bandwidth each year

symbols.name: compute growth factor
symbols.meaning: ~1.6x/yr, the ~18-month doubling

symbols.name: bandwidth growth factor
symbols.meaning: ~1.2x/yr, memory signaling improves slowly

title: Iron law, additive form: one request end to end
caption: Use this when memory, compute, and overhead all sit on one dependent path: they add. This is what a single request's latency pays.

symbols.name: request latency
symbols.meaning: end-to-end time for one unit of work

symbols.name: memory term
symbols.meaning: bytes moved divided by bandwidth

symbols.name: compute term
symbols.meaning: operations divided by achieved rate (peak x hardware efficiency)

symbols.name: fixed overhead
symbols.meaning: latency that survives at zero work: launches, RTTs, setup

title: Bottleneck principle: overlapped stream bound
caption: For an ideally overlapped stream, the interval between completions is set by the single slowest stage. Speeding any other stage buys nothing for throughput.

symbols.name: per-task interval
symbols.meaning: steady-state time between completed tasks once the pipeline fills

symbols.name: memory stage
symbols.meaning: D_vol / BW: bytes moved at bandwidth

symbols.name: compute stage
symbols.meaning: O / (R_peak x eta_hw): operations at achieved rate

symbols.name: transfer stage
symbols.meaning: storage or network link time; deployment adds it to the race

symbols.name: fixed overhead
symbols.meaning: non-overlapped cost paid per task, sits outside the max

title: System balance: the ridge point
caption: The platform's balance point in FLOPs per byte. A workload whose arithmetic intensity sits above I* is compute-bound; below it, bandwidth-bound. Same model, different batch, different side.

symbols.name: ridge point
symbols.meaning: the arithmetic intensity where memory and compute cost the same time

symbols.name: peak compute rate
symbols.meaning: maximum FLOPs/s the silicon contract offers

symbols.name: memory bandwidth
symbols.meaning: bytes/s the machine can stream

title: Data locality invariant: remote-path lower bound
caption: An idealized bound that omits remote queueing, serialization, and memory movement. If even this misses the deadline, the remote path is rejected; surviving it only earns a complete-path measurement.

symbols.name: remote-path bound
symbols.meaning: optimistic total time for offload; the screen compares it to the deadline

symbols.name: transmission term
symbols.meaning: time to push the input over the uplink; cannot be bought down by remote compute

symbols.name: network latency
symbols.meaning: propagation + routing + protocol handshakes, round trip

symbols.name: remote compute term
symbols.meaning: the only term remote hardware improves; often the smallest one
